property_mappings.reasoning: The column 'callsign' is a flight name, and 'alternateName' is the most appropriate property for a name that is not the primary concept name.
The column 'time' is a timestamp and directly matches the property 'observationDateTime' of the Observation class.
The column 'velocity' is a speed in m/s and directly matches the property 'speedMetersPerSecond' of the Velocity class.
The column 'heading' is an angle in degrees and matches the property 'absoluteBearingAngle' which represents the direction of movement.
The ontology has 'hasVelocity' as an object property, and the data includes velocity and heading which are properties of the Velocity class.
The column 'baroaltitude' is an altitude in meters and directly matches the property 'altitudeMeters' of the Altitude class.
The ontology has 'hasAltitude' as an object property, and the data includes barometric altitude which is a property of the Altitude class.
The column 'lat' is latitude in decimal degrees and directly matches the property 'latitudeDecimal' of AbsolutePoint.
The column 'lon' is longitude in decimal degrees and directly matches the property 'longitudeDecimal' of AbsolutePoint.
The Location class has 'hasGeometry' to link to a Geometry, and the data's lat/lon are best captured by a Point geometry.
The ontology uses 'hasGeographicLocation' to link to a Location, and the data provides latitude and longitude which are best represented through a Location with a Point geometry.
The ontology defines 'hasObservation' on Vehicle (and thus Aircraft) to link to Observation entities, and each record represents an observation of the aircraft at a point in time.

subject_mappings.reasoning: The column 'icao24' is a unique transponder code for an aircraft, and the ontology class 'Aircraft' directly matches the entity type of the data source.
